summary: Global Mofy AI Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting that CFO and Director Chen Chen resigned effective April 29, 2026, with no disagreement with company operations. The Board immediately appointed Yinping Ma as CFO, effective the same date, under a two-year employment agreement with automatic annual renewals. Ms. Ma receives compensation of RMB144,000 (~$20,000) per year, payable monthly. This is a routine CFO succession filing reflecting a resignation and replacement without disclosed conflicts or past transactions. No other special-situation elements are present. This event is classified as Management Changes, as the abrupt CFO resignation constitutes the triggering event.
